articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo in mid-August, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video with a 1-million-token context window. Benchmarks show a 35% improvement on complex multi-step reasoning tasks compared to GPT-4.5, with significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model also introduces a new structured output mode that produces verified, schema-compliant JSON natively.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on GPQA-Diamond and several scientific reasoning benchmarks, approaching expert-level performance in graduate-level physics and molecular biology. The model incorporates a novel chain-of-verification architecture that cross-checks intermediate reasoning steps. Google is integrating the model into its research tools across Google Cloud and Google Labs.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla announced that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has begun operating in limited production roles at two of its Gigafactories, handling component sorting, quality inspection, and light assembly tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for dynamic task adaptation. Tesla plans to scale to external industrial customers by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robot Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Operations
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a massive $1.5 billion Series C round, valuing the company at over $12 billion, following demonstrations of its Figure 02 robot autonomously managing pick-and-pack warehouse workflows for over 8-hour shifts. The robot leverages a foundation world model for spatial reasoning and adapts to novel objects without retraining. Major logistics partners including a top-three US retailer have signed pilot agreements.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Auditing Framework for Enterprise Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic released a comprehensive open-source framework for auditing and certifying AI system alignment in enterprise environments, building on its constitutional AI research. The toolkit provides automated red-teaming pipelines, behavioral boundary verification, and continuous monitoring for deployed models. Several Fortune 500 companies in finance and healthcare have already adopted the framework as part of their AI governance stack.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Enabling Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has entered volume production at its Fab 22 facility in Kaohsiung, with initial capacity allocated to next-generation AI accelerator chips. The node delivers approximately 25% performance gains and 30% power efficiency improvements over N2, critical for training increasingly large foundation models. First customer silicon is expected to ship in products by early 2027.

articles.title: Meta Unveils AR Glasses with Full Holographic Display and On-Device LLM Processing
articles.summary: Meta officially launched its Orion consumer AR glasses featuring a full-color holographic waveguide display and a custom silicon chip capable of running a distilled Llama 4 model entirely on-device. The glasses support real-time contextual AI assistance, spatial computing interactions, and all-day battery life in a form factor resembling conventional eyewear. Priced at $1,299, they represent a significant step toward mainstream mixed-reality adoption.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits Targeting High-Risk Systems
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act, targeting high-risk AI systems in healthcare diagnostics, credit scoring, and border surveillance across multiple member states. Companies face requirements including mandatory technical documentation, bias testing, and human oversight provisions, with penalties of up to 7% of global revenue for non-compliance. The enforcement wave is reshaping how global tech companies architect and document their AI pipelines for the European market.
